# silk-socket.io-client-node

Various hacks we need to make to socket.io-client.

 - Add true support for sending binary over WS


## Patching workflow:

The primary purpose of this repo is to patch nested node modules to
provide a pure js socket.io client interface which meets our
requirements for socket.io usage. To edit things you need to flow these
steps:


### Editing files:

The `patches/*` files are generated by this process.

First run `./tools/checkout` this only needs to be run once and will
apply current patches. Now edit `modified/node_modues/` and use
`./tools/build` to update `index.js` (which you can use in react-native
apps). When you ready to commit run: `./tools/patch` which will guide
you through creating a new patch file. Once the patch file has been
added to `patches` commit it and `index.js`.
